notes: An emitted goto must have its label. This function's switch default arm jumps to the no-return tail at 0x2701, and the tail-duplication pass used to release that label because its survivng-carrier census only saw BlockGoto/BlockIf carriers -- the arm printed `goto label_2701;` with no `label_2701:` anywhere in the function (gcc -fsyntax-only: error: label 'label_2701' used but not defined).
